title: The 16 Best Drip Coffee Makers of 2026
h1: The 16 Best Drip Coffee Makers of 2026
metaDescription: Our 16 picks for drip coffee makers of 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at drip coffee makers of 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Technivorm Moccamaster KBG Select
strengths: SCAA certified, brews at the correct temperature every time
Copper heating element reaches brewing temperature in 6 minutes total brew time for 10 cups
Dutch manufacturing with a 5-year warranty, the longest in this category
Spray arm saturates the entire coffee bed evenly, no dry spots
Available in 20+ colors
limitations: No programmable timer, manual brew only
Carafe is glass (thermal available as the Moccamaster KBGT)
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: OXO Brew 9-Cup Coffee Maker
products.blurb: Key specs: SCAA certified, 9-cup, Rainshower head.
strengths: SCAA certified with programmable timer, Moccamaster performance with scheduling
Rainshower head distributes water evenly across the coffee bed
Thermal carafe option available
More approachable price than Moccamaster
limitations: 9-cup capacity, smaller than standard 12-cup models
More complex to program than a basic coffee maker

products.name: Bonavita 8-Cup One-Touch Coffee Maker
products.blurb: Key specs: SCAA certified, 8-cup, Thermal carafe.
strengths: Thermal carafe keeps coffee at quality temperature without a heating plate
One-touch operation, no programming complexity
limitations: 8-cup capacity, one size below standard 12-cup models
No programmable timer, requires manual start
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Cuisinart DCC-3200P1 Perfectemp 14-Cup
products.blurb: Key specs: 14-cup, Programmable, Brew strength control.
strengths: 14-cup, the largest capacity in this list, correct for offices and large households
Brew strength settings (regular and bold)
Programmable 24-hour timer
limitations: Not SCAA certified, brews at approximately 185 to 195°F
Glass carafe with heating plate

products.name: Breville Precision Brewer Thermal
products.blurb: Key specs: SCAA certified, 12-cup thermal, Programmable.
strengths: SCAA certified with 12-cup thermal carafe and programmable timer, the most complete package
Gold filter included (reusable), saves paper filter cost
Multiple brewing modes including Gold Cup (SCAA standard), Fast, and Over Ice
Single Cup attachment for 12oz brewing without filling the full carafe
limitations: More complex than simpler coffee makers
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Hamilton Beach 12-Cup Programmable Coffee Maker
strengths: 12-hour programmable timer
Brew strength setting
limitations: Not SCAA certified, brewing temperature below optimal
Glass carafe heating plate degrades coffee quickly
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Mr. Coffee 12-Cup Programmable Coffee Maker
strengths: Very affordable
Programmable delay start for morning coffee
12-cup glass carafe for households
Simple controls with pause-and-serve
limitations: Glass carafe on a hot plate can make coffee taste stewed over time
Brews cooler than specialty-certified brewers
Plastic build

products.name: Ninja CE251 12-Cup Programmable Coffee Maker
strengths: Brew style selection (classic, rich, over ice)

products.name: Cuisinart Thermal 12-Cup Coffee Maker
strengths: Thermal carafe, no heating plate, coffee holds quality longer
Cuisinart reliability
limitations: Not SCAA certified at this price tier

products.name: Bunn Speed Brew Elite 10-Cup Coffee Maker
strengths: Brews 10 cups in approximately 3 minutes, the fastest drip coffee maker
Commercial-grade build quality
Consistent hot water temperature (BUNN keeps tank pre-heated)
limitations: Always-on water tank consumes power continuously
No programmable timer

products.name: Technivorm Moccamaster KBGT Thermal
products.blurb: Key specs: SCAA certified, 10-cup thermal, Dutch made.
strengths: Moccamaster quality with thermal carafe (no heating plate)
SCAA certified at optimal brewing temperature
Coffee holds quality for 1 to 2 hours in the thermal carafe
limitations: No programmable timer

products.name: Behmor Brazen Plus Coffee Maker
products.blurb: Key specs: SCAA certified, 8-cup, Pulse brew technology.
strengths: SCAA certified at optimal temperature
Oversized shower head with pulse-brew turbulence for full saturation, a distinctive brewing method
Adjustable temperature and brew strength controls
limitations: Premium pricing among drip coffee makers
8-cup capacity limits household use for 4+ person households
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Braun KF7150BK BrewSense Drip Coffee Maker
products.blurb: Key specs: SCAA certified, 12-cup, PureFlavor technology.
strengths: SCA-certified brewing performance
Programmable timer and brew-strength control
Charcoal water filter
Good value for a certified brewer
limitations: Glass carafe with hot plate
Plastic housing
Not as fast as some brewers
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Hamilton Beach 2-Way Brewer 12-Cup and Single Serve
products.blurb: Key specs: Drip + single serve, 12-cup + pod, Hamilton Beach.
strengths: Brews a full pot or a single cup
Uses ground coffee, not pods
Programmable carafe side
Good value for households with mixed needs
limitations: Large footprint
Two brewing systems to clean
Glass carafe on a hot plate

products.name: Keurig K-Duo Hot & Iced Single Serve and Carafe Coffee Maker
strengths: Pods and ground-coffee carafe in one machine
Iced coffee setting
Large 72 oz shared reservoir
MultiStream brewing for even extraction
limitations: Takes more counter space than single-serve models
Carafe side is basic compared with dedicated drip machines
Two brewing systems to clean

products.name: BLACK+DECKER 12-Cup Drip Coffee Maker with Vortex Brewing
strengths: Very low price for 12 cups
Vortex showerhead saturates grounds evenly
Pause-and-serve for a mid-brew cup
Easy to use
limitations: Glass carafe on a hot plate can scorch coffee over time
Plastic build
Basic controls

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
